I'm sorry, Sophia, but unfortunately insurance cannot be added to a reservation after the initial booking — this is a firm policy limitation, and it applies regardless of the circumstances.

Since insurance wasn't selected when reservation PEP4E0 was originally created, I'm unable to add it now. There's nothing I or a human agent can do to change this.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

Wait, that doesn't seem right. I'm pretty sure I added it during booking. Can you double-check my reservation to see if the insurance is actually there? And I really don't want to be transferred to someone else - can you just look into this more carefully for me? Everyone else in my family has insurance and I need to have it too.

I've already pulled up your reservation details — the tool data confirms that insurance is set to **no** on reservation PEP4E0. There's no discrepancy to investigate further; it simply wasn't added at the time of booking.

Unfortunately, per our policy, insurance cannot be added after a reservation is made. I'm not able to make an exception to this, and this is something a human agent also cannot override.

Is there anything else I can help you with?

There has to be a way to fix this. My whole family has insurance except me and I need it for my flight. Please, isn't there someone or some way you can help me get this resolved without transferring me?

I understand this is frustrating, and I'm sorry you're in this situation. However, I don't have access to booking history logs or confirmation emails — the reservation record is the source of truth, and it shows insurance was not added.

I also want to be clear: this is a policy limitation, not a system error I can escalate. No one on our end can add insurance to an existing booking, regardless of what happened during checkout.

I'm unable to make an exception here. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
